name: mainline_cohort_evidence_v1

evidence_role.original: Frozen initialization-propagation confirmation before terminal development.
evidence_role.modified: Opened-cohort terminal development; not independent confirmation of the new terminal.

evidence_role.original: Prespecified original-terminal comparator on fresh geometries.
evidence_role.modified: Independent fresh-geometry confirmation of the frozen new terminal and models.

metric_definitions.certification: I(certified and truly feasible); false certificates separately counted.
metric_definitions.reward: I(certified and truly feasible) * deployed quality.
metric_definitions.quality_increment: I(certified and truly feasible) * (deployed quality - best true-feasible initial10 quality). Signed, not clipped; zero for uncertified completed runs; missing execution remains unknown.
metric_definitions.best_initial_reference: I(certified and truly feasible) * best true-feasible initial10 quality. Descriptive decomposition, not a hypothetical certificate for that initial policy.
metric_definitions.good_new_deployment: Certified, truly feasible, outside initial10, and better than best true-feasible initial10.
metric_definitions.weighting: Each cohort separately: four geometries per family, three equally weighted known families; no pooled 24-geometry confirmation.

scope: Saved result JSON and initial policy identities only. No model edits, restoration, raw replay, RNG draws, simulation, verification, truth evaluation, fit or download.

decision.conclusion: Initialization transfer remains the working candidate; development and independent confirmation stay separate, with concentrated certification and quality contributions.
decision.next_step: Connect independent observation_seed routing and logging, fixed saved neighbor banks, and modified-terminal-only execution; validate with deterministic stubs before new real calls.
